steps: Party-size chips are a regular Buy 5 Save $5 Mega item at $3.49 tagged
Mega discount drops each bag $1 → $2.49
Load the Kroger digital "$5 off 5 Frito-Lay" coupon → another $1 off each
Final: $1.49 per party-size bag
Add an Ibotta snack rebate if one is live for the brand
deals.src: Kroger Mega Event snack anchor — Southern Savers Kroger matchup
deals.tip: Party-size bags qualify for the Mega at the same $1 discount as small bags — always take the biggest qualifying size for the best unit price.

deals.title: Snacks & Crackers — Free to 50¢ with Everyday Coupon Doubling
steps: Harris Teeter doubles manufacturer coupons up to 99¢ every single day (20 per day)
A 75¢ snack coupon becomes $1.50 off
Pair a doubled coupon with a weekly sale price around $1.50–$2 → free to 50¢
Stack an e-VIC digital offer loaded to your VIC card on the same item
During Super Doubles events coupons up to $2 double — a $2 coupon = $4 off
deals.exp: Doubling daily; Super Doubles announced in ad
deals.src: Harris Teeter coupon policy (everyday doubling to 99¢) + Southern Savers Super Doubles tracker
deals.tip: Everyday doubling makes Harris Teeter the best coupon store in the Carolinas even outside events — bring twenty 75¢ coupons and each is worth $1.50.

deals.title: Chips & Snacks 2/$6 — $1.50 a Bag After Cash Rewards
steps: Large bags of chips on sale 2/$6
Earn $3 Walgreens Cash Rewards when you buy 2
Clip any snack digital coupon in the myWalgreens app
Final: $3 for two bags = $1.50 each
Roll the Cash Rewards into the same trip's next deal
deals.src: Walgreens weekly ad snack promo — recurring hip2save matchup
deals.tip: Walgreens Cash Rewards are spendable in the same visit — do the snack deal first, then apply the rewards to household essentials before leaving.

deals.title: Snack Aisle — 60% Off with MVP + Shop & Earn Stack
steps: Activate Shop & Earn snack-category offers in the Food Lion app at the start of the month
Buy MVP-tagged snack sale items in those categories
Stack manufacturer coupons on each item
Shop & Earn rewards load automatically and apply as instant savings on your next trip
Effective final: roughly 60% off the shelf price
deals.src: Food Lion MVP Shop & Earn program mechanics
deals.tip: Shop & Earn offers reset on the 1st and must be activated before they count — set a monthly reminder or you leave the entire rewards layer on the table.

deals.title: General Mills Cereal — 99¢ a Box in the Mega Event
steps: Cereal is a standing Mega Event item — Buy 5 Save $5 puts boxes at about $1.99
Load the Kroger digital "$1 off 2 General Mills" coupon
Stack a General Mills insert coupon (they run near-monthly)
Add the Ibotta cereal rebate when live
Final: 99¢ per box
deals.src: Kroger Mega Event cereal anchor — Southern Savers Kroger matchup
deals.tip: Cereal is the most reliably couponed category in the store. Under $1 a box is the stock-up threshold — buy a month's worth when it hits.

deals.title: H-E-B Bakery Bread — $1 a Loaf with Digital Coupon
steps: H-E-B store-brand bakery bread runs $1.48–$1.98 on the weekly ad
Clip the H-E-B digital bakery coupon in the app (rotates weekly, often 50¢–$1 off)
Final: around $1.00 a loaf
Check the reduced-price bakery rack after 7pm for an additional 30–50% off
deals.src: H-E-B weekly ad bakery pricing + app digital coupon rotation
deals.tip: H-E-B marks bakery down hard in the evening. Stacking an app coupon on an already-marked-down loaf is the cheapest bread in Texas — and it freezes fine.

deals.title: Eggs, Milk & Butter — The National Price Floor
steps: Aldi holds the lowest everyday price on the four staples nearly every week: eggs, milk, butter, shredded cheese
No card, no clipping, no coupon required
Weekly ad "Aldi Finds" drop Wednesdays adds rotating pantry deals
Check the Ibotta Aldi gallery — it pays out on Aldi store brands too
Use these prices as the benchmark for every other stack in the app
deals.src: Aldi everyday staple pricing — the reference point for matchup blogs
deals.tip: The highest-value habit in couponing: buy staples at Aldi, and save your coupon energy for the national-brand categories where stacking actually multiplies.

deals.title: Cheese & Yogurt BOGO — Two for the Price of One, Minus Two Coupons
steps: Dairy hits the Publix BOGO list most weeks (shredded cheese, yogurt multipacks, cream cheese)
Both items ring at half price in BOGO markets
Use two manufacturer coupons — one on each item
Stack a Publix digital coupon where one exists on the same product
Typical landing: $1.50–$2.00 per unit on $4.49 retail
deals.src: Publix weekly BOGO dairy list — I Heart Publix matchup
deals.tip: Publix BOGO cycles run about 6 weeks per product. When your staple hits BOGO, buy the full 6-week supply — cheese freezes, yogurt dates run long.

deals.title: Boneless Chicken Breast — $1.77/lb on the Weekly Ad Low
steps: Harris Teeter runs boneless skinless chicken breast to $1.77–$1.99/lb on rotation
Buy the family pack — the ad price usually requires it
Stack an e-VIC digital meat offer if one is loaded to your card
Portion and freeze the same day in meal-size bags
Watch the manager markdown stickers in the morning for an extra 30% on same-day-sell meat
deals.src: Harris Teeter weekly ad meat rotation — Southern Savers Harris Teeter matchup
deals.tip: Meat is where coupons don't reach, so the entire game is the ad cycle plus markdown timing. Under $2/lb on chicken breast is the stock-up trigger.

deals.title: H-E-B Meat Market Ground Beef — $2.97/lb Family Pack
steps: 80/20 ground beef family packs hit $2.97–$3.27/lb on the H-E-B ad
Check the Combo Loco block — ground beef is a frequent anchor with free buns, cheese or seasoning
Clip any H-E-B digital meat coupon in the app
Look for the red "Reduced for Quick Sale" stickers in the morning meat case for another 30%
deals.src: H-E-B weekly ad meat pricing + Combo Loco mechanics
deals.tip: H-E-B Combo Loco on ground beef routinely throws in buns and cheese free — a full burger night for the price of the meat alone.

deals.title: Frozen Meals & Veg — 30–40% Off with Circle + Gift Card Stack
steps: Frozen runs a recurring buy N get a Target gift card promo
Stack Target Circle percent-off offers on individual frozen brands
Add manufacturer coupons at the register — Target allows one store + one manufacturer coupon per item
Submit Ibotta frozen-category rebates
Typical: 35–45% off the frozen aisle in one trip
deals.src: Target weekly ad frozen gift-card promo — hip2save Target matchup
deals.tip: Target's one-store-plus-one-manufacturer-coupon-per-item policy is the most generous of the mass retailers. Frozen is where it pays off most.

deals.title: Pantry Stock-Up — $25 Cart for $12 (Saturday $5/$25 + Digitals)
steps: Shop Saturday only — clip the $5 off $25 digital coupon in the DG app
Build the cart from sale-tagged pantry staples: pasta, sauce, rice, canned beans, cereal, peanut butter
Clip every item-level DG digital coupon that matches your cart (they stack with the $5/$25)
Add manufacturer coupons — DG accepts one per item alongside its own digital
Typical landing: a $25 shelf-price cart for $12–$15
Split larger hauls into separate $25 transactions — the $5/$25 is one per transaction
deals.src: Dollar General Saturday $5/$25 + Digital Coupon stacking policy
deals.tip: The $5/$25 threshold is measured on the shelf-price subtotal before digital coupons come off, so load up to $25 first and let the coupons take it down from there.

deals.title: Pasta, Sauce & Canned Goods — $5 off $25 Smart Coupon Stack
steps: Clip the Saturday $5 off $25 Smart Coupon in the Family Dollar app
Fill the cart with sale-tagged pantry staples
Stack item-level Smart Coupons on individual products
Important: at Family Dollar the $5/$25 applies after item coupons — build the cart to land above $25 post-coupon
Typical: $35 of pantry goods for under $20
deals.src: Family Dollar Smart Coupons stacking order
deals.tip: This is the one threshold coupon that calculates AFTER item coupons — the opposite of Dollar General. Aim for $25.01 post-coupon or the $5 simply won't fire.

deals.title: Pasta & Sauce BOGO — Two Jars for $2.29 Total
steps: Pasta sauce hits the Publix BOGO list — $4.29 becomes $2.15 each
Apply two $1 manufacturer coupons, one per jar
Final: $2.29 for two jars — $1.15 each
Pair with BOGO dry pasta the same week for a complete meal base under $2
deals.src: Publix weekly BOGO pantry list — I Heart Publix matchup
deals.tip: Pasta and sauce almost always BOGO in the same week at Publix — that pairing is the cheapest reliable dinner base in the Southeast.

deals.title: Fresh Rewards Personal Prices + Weekly Free Item
steps: Open the Fresh Rewards app — personal prices are generated from your own purchase history
Clip the weekly app freebie (a full-size item, most weeks)
Stack manufacturer coupons on personal-price items
Lowes Foods also runs strong local produce pricing — check the ad before Harris Teeter
deals.src: Lowes Foods Fresh Rewards program mechanics
deals.tip: The weekly free item alone justifies the app. Personal prices differ per account, so check both adults' logins and shop whichever is better that week.

deals.title: Paper Towels & Toilet Paper — 40% Off with the $15 Gift Card Stack
steps: Buy $50 of household essentials (paper goods, laundry, cleaning)
Receive a $15 Target gift card at checkout during the recurring essentials event
Stack Target Circle offers (5–30% off individual brands)
Add manufacturer coupons at the register — one store + one manufacturer coupon per item is allowed
Layer Ibotta rebates on Bounty, Charmin and Tide
Effective: 35–45% total savings on the trip
deals.src: Target essentials gift-card event — recurring hip2save Target matchup
deals.tip: Time the paper-goods restock to the gift-card event and roll the card into the next one. Run back to back, this keeps household paper permanently ~40% off.

deals.title: Dish Soap, Cleaners & Laundry — Rollback + Ibotta Double Dip
steps: Walmart takes no store coupons — rebate apps are the entire stack
Shop the rollback tags on Dawn, Tide, Clorox and Lysol
Activate matching Ibotta rebates before checkout
Check Checkout 51 for the same items — the two apps occasionally both pay on one purchase
Scan the receipt in Fetch for points on top
deals.src: Walmart rollback pricing + rebate app double-dip mechanics
deals.tip: The Ibotta + Checkout 51 double dip on one receipt is the closest thing to coupon stacking Walmart allows. Always check both galleries before a household run.
